proposed_widenings.name: stateful_vehicle_magic_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is not an always-on grant or a one-shot activation. It is a persistent controllable object/vehicle with its own statistics, occupancy, sealed-compartment state, movement/attack affordances gated by lever positions, and environmental rules. The current magic-item surface has no family for a stateful vehicle or object that remains in play and is operated through repeated control inputs.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. if the legs aren't extended); Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. Honest encoding would need a new persistent vehicle/object family with crew/occupancy state, lever-controlled mode changes, and onboard movement/attack procedures. Treating the levers as ordinary activation phases would lose the item's persistent state and produce a misleading trace.
